title: Resolution Is Not Settlement, Part II: Protocol Finality and Observed Redemption on Polymarket
abstract: arXiv:2609.15373v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: An Oracle result is not yet a protocol payout, a redeemable position is not yet collateral in a holder's account, and a redemption event is not a complete measure of economic entitlement. This companion paper develops an event-sourced framework for Polymarket conditions from preparation through protocol finality and observed holder realization.   The empirical design uses three Conditional Tokens Framework event families derived from a pinned contract application binary interface (ABI): ConditionPreparation, ConditionResolution, and PayoutRedemption. It separates the contract-wide acquisition universe from the frozen Polymarket adapter-question cohort. The exact bridge contains 108,638 linked conditions. Of these, 99,283 have an observed protocol-resolution event by the fixed snapshot at Polygon block 90,114,204 (2026-07-12T17:11:41Z). translated_title: 裁定并非结算（第二部分）：Polymarket 上的协议最终性与已观测赎回
translated_abstract: 预言机结果尚不等于协议赔付，可赎回头寸尚不等于持有人账户中的抵押品，赎回事件也不是经济权益的完整度量。这篇姊妹篇论文构建了一个事件溯源框架，用于追踪 Polymarket 条件从准备阶段到协议最终性再到观测到的持有人实现的全过程。实证设计使用源自固定合约应用程序二进制接口（ABI）的三个条件代币框架事件族：ConditionPreparation（条件准备）、ConditionResolution（条件裁定）和 PayoutRedemption（赔付赎回）。该方法将合约范围的获取全集与冻结的 Polymarket 适配器-问题队列区分开来。精确桥接包含 108,638 个关联条件。其中，99,283 个在 Polygon 区块 90,114,204（2026-07-12T17:11:41Z）的固定快照之前有观测到的协议裁定事件。在已裁定的精确关联条件中，92,158 个有观测到的任意金额赎回，91,817 个……
tldr: 该论文构建了从条件准备到协议最终性再到实际赎回的事件溯源分析框架，发现在 Polymarket 的 108,638 个精确关联条件中，99,283 个已有观测到的协议裁定事件，其中 92,158 个发生了任意金额的赎回，揭示了从市场裁定到持有人实际实现经济权益之间存在显著缺口。
en_tdlr: This paper develops an event-sourced framework tracking Polymarket conditions from preparation through protocol finality to observed redemption, finding that among 108,638 exactly linked conditions, 99,283 had observed protocol resolutions and 92,158 exhibited redemptions of any amount, revealing a notable gap between market resolution and holders' actual economic realization.
